label_rule.rule: Lists are stored with the name printed in the commission’s minutes. A name containing a person’s name is shown by the short name the commission publishes in its own result data file (knaz). title_sha256 identifies the printed name. Candidate names, dates of birth and addresses printed in the minutes are never stored.
